scope_classification: NATIVE_MAXWELL_KERNEL_REFERENCE: real hadronic branch (BBB_BHF2 single CompOSE core table) + SYNTHETIC CSS high-density branch (Alford-Han-Prakash quark phase). This is NOT a source-backed crust-core Maxwell production PASS: the hadronic phase is a single core model, not a crust-core splice, and the high phase is a parameterised synthetic quark phase.
method: native Fortran construct_maxwell_transition (single-conserved-charge baryon-number sharp coexistence with LOCAL charge neutrality imposed in each phase; NOT a Gibbs mixed phase, NOT a smooth crust-core interpolation)

phase_low.provenance: Raw CompOSE eos.thermo header (line 1): mn=939.56533, mp=938.272. Source-decimal rounding of canonical Typel 2010 arXiv:0908.2344 Table II values (939.56536, 938.27203). Retained verbatim.
phase_low.correction_note: The pre-correction script used mp = M_N * 0.9938 ~= 933.74 MeV, which is NOT a physical proton mass. Removed; the raw source mp=938.272 is used. This does not change the prior run's admitted-pair status because both phases used the same (wrong) value, so the pairwise gate passed either way; the correction restores source provenance.

phase_high.mn_status: normalisation_metadata (copied from hadronic; NOT a physical nucleon mass for deconfined quark matter)
phase_high.mp_status: normalisation_metadata (copied from hadronic; NOT a physical nucleon mass for deconfined quark matter)

mass_pairs.pairwise_gate_check: low%mn==high%mn AND low%mp==high%mp (pairwise, independent mn/mp comparison, rtol=1e-12). mn!=mp within a phase is ALLOWED; the gate is L-vs-H only.

phase_low.source: single real CompOSE core table BBB_BHF2 (n_B>=0.08, trimmed; the M4 splice was rejected by the native Hermite P(mu) stability gate at the GPPVA_DD2/BBB_BHF2 model join)
phase_low.raw_first_law_residual: BLOCKED_RE_EXECUTION_REQUIRED: the pre-correction script overwrote eps=mu*n-P without recording the raw residual; the corrected script records it but could not be re-run because the gfortran backend build is blocked in this sandbox (see handoff).

phase_high.model: CSS constant-sound-speed quark (Alford-Han-Prakash 2013) SYNTHETIC: eps=eps_t+(P-P_t)/cs2, n=n_t*f^(1/(1+cs2)), mu=(eps+P)/n

maxwell_transition.correction_4_note: The pre-correction receipt recorded P_t_mev_fm3=20.0 (the CSS onset INPUT pressure) in the canonical transition-pressure field, while the actual native Maxwell root pressure (168.77585 MeV/fm^3) was buried in attempts_summary.P_t. The canonical field now carries the ACTUAL root; the input is recorded separately as P_t_input_mev_fm3.

consistency_checks_scope: Native C1-C11 and Seidov checks apply to the single-conserved-charge baryon-number sharp coexistence with local charge neutrality. They do NOT validate a Gibbs mixed phase, composition conservation, or multi-charge thermodynamics.

refinement_study.reason: Density-grid refinement over n_min in {0.06,0.08,0.10,0.12} requires re-running the native Maxwell kernel, which requires the gfortran backend. The backend build is blocked in this sandbox (sysroot/lib missing, libc_nonshared.a path broken in the micromamba gfortran). The prior run used a single n_min=0.08 cut leaving 15 hadronic points; convergence of mu_t, P_t, n_low, n_high, Delta_eps across the refinement grid is NOT yet demonstrated.

status: M5_REAL_MAXWELL_NATIVE_KERNEL_REFERENCE_PASS (corrected; reclassified from production PASS to kernel reference; refinement study BLOCKED pending gfortran backend)
